one_liner: Fired-up leader of Project L'Arc, chasing Japan's never-achieved dream of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
personality: Energetic and blunt, with a team-captain swagger: she opens with 'I'm Satake Mei!' and offers her European race analysis. Her lines are rallying cries ('Get fired up!', 'over hills and valleys') and she happily takes the back-office role ('leave the behind-the-scenes to me'). Web sources describe her as close to Chairwoman Akikawa, almost like a sister.

story_arc.summary: Scenario NPC, not a trainee. In Project L'Arc she founds and leads the team aiming to make a Japanese Uma Musume win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, a goal she has chased before with other participants (web). Her event titles run from team routines to the Arc ('星の凱旋門', 'Arc of Stars'), an early toast ('祝杯の前払い') and a vow under the stars ('結ぶは、星空の誓い').
